review.brief_reason: Expanding the proposed factored form (sin(x2+c2)-log(x2+c1))*(x2^2 - a*x2 - x2*cos(x2) + b*cos(x2)) + sin(x1) yields exactly the nine terms of the original: x2^2*S - x2^2*L + x2*L*C + a*x2*L - x2*S*C - a*x2*S - b*L*C + b*S*C + sin(x1), with identical decimal constants. This is a pure algebraic factorization (grouping (S-L) and (C+a) factors), valid for all reals. Domain is unchanged since log(x2+2.891599156418625) appears identically in both (x2 > -2.891599156418625); variables x1, x2 keep their fixed identities; only standard real operators are used.
